# Helvety Notes

> Encrypted notes with titles and rich text in Personal, Work, and Other groups. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Product behavior
- Encrypted titles and rich-text bodies in Personal, Work, and Other groups
- New note opens an empty editor sheet (save-first create); the record is stored on first save with a client-generated id
- Shareable links use `?note=<uuid>` to open a note in the detail sheet after sign-in and vault unlock
- Optional cross-app links to Helvety Tasks, Contacts, and Links when those apps are in use

## Canonical URL
- [Notes App](https://helvety.com/notes): Auth-required notes route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Notes routes are intended not to be indexed.
- Gateway `https://helvety.com/robots.txt` disallows `/notes` (canonical crawl policy). Zone `/notes/robots.txt` is a host-absolute mirror. Routes also use noindex and authentication controls.
